A1.justification: Both complete 14-page PDFs describe the same STAND work. The main text, equations, Figures 1–6, Tables 1–9, Algorithm 1 and Appendices A–B are readable and directly matchable.

before.justification: v2 reports original decoding experiments, throughput and acceptance-length measurements, and ablations in Section 5 and Appendix B, alongside the analyses in Section 3.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including evaluations on AIME-2024, GPQA-Diamond and LiveCodeBench and the appendix experiments.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and Algorithm 1 retain the same logit-based N-gram storage and aggregation, stochastic drafting, Gumbel-Top-K sampling and data-driven tree construction. No revised STAND procedure is described.

E1.justification: All identified datasets and inference scenarios are retained. However, v3 adds a pruning-ratio table on page 14 without identifying its dataset or task, so whether this addition changes evaluation coverage cannot be determined.

E2.justification: Tables 1–9 retain their comparator sets, including the same Token Recycle baseline. The added page-14 table has rows named Initial and Think-Attn but no STAND row or explanation, preventing verification of any new comparator evaluated against STAND.

E3.justification: The established evaluation settings are unchanged, including temperature 0.6, 30 samples per task, A100 hardware and 80-token drafts. The new table lists pruning ratios of 0%, 5%, 10%, 15% and 20%, but supplies no experimental setup or metric, leaving its protocol implications unresolved.

E4.justification: The existing ablations, tree analyses and appendix investigations are unchanged. The new pruning-ratio table suggests a sensitivity analysis, but neither the pruned component nor the measured outcome is defined, so its analytical role cannot be reliably established.

E5.justification: Neither version supplies repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The existing reporting of averages is unchanged, and the new table adds no identified uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–9 retain their results. v3 adds ten numerical entries in the unexplained pruning table: at 20% pruning, Initial is 0.8791 and Think-Attn is 0.8741. These are added values with an unspecified metric, not evidence of changed STAND performance.

T1.justification: The speculative-sampling acceptance and resampling reasoning in Section 3.2, the Gumbel-Top-K formula in Section 4.2 and the mathematical definitions are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims, including lossless model-free acceleration, 60–65% latency reduction and applicability across inference patterns without additional training.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, result interpretations and Appendix B discussions are unchanged. The limitations concerning HuggingFace evaluation, Python lookup overhead and unverified transfer to optimized serving frameworks remain identical. The new table receives no interpretation.

D1.justification: STAND's implementation and reproducibility disclosures remain unchanged, including top-10 probability storage, tree initialization, the shared evaluation codebase and Appendix A's batch and DVTS details. No new code/data access instructions or explanation of the added table are provided.

R1.justification: Section 2 replaces Geva et al. (2023) with Luo et al. (2024), and the separate Geva bibliography entry is removed. Luo was already cited for Token Recycle in v2. This is a limited citation substitution and removal without broader changes in research positioning.

P1.justification: The citation/reference edits and updated arXiv version/date line are limited textual changes. The explanatory prose, terminology and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 adds a small unnumbered, uncaptioned pruning table above Appendix B.4, shifting that discussion downward. Minor page and column reflow occurs elsewhere; the existing figures, numbered tables and algorithm retain their designs and content.

improvement.justification: The method, established evidence and core claims are unchanged. Aligning the related-work citation with the existing Token Recycle reference offers a small consistency benefit, but the added appendix table lacks a caption, metric, experimental context and connection to STAND. This introduces a limited loss of clarity and assessability without identifiable additional support for the paper.
